skills.name: audit-feed
skills.description: The auditor's pass over the shared feed - every line that needs a verdict gets PASS, FLAG or FAIL with evidence, signed with the auditor's key.

skills.name: check-fence
skills.description: Ask before acting - may this bot use this tool now, given the auditor's PASS and Simon's signed go?

skills.name: daily-rollup
skills.description: Kar's daily rollup of the shared feed for AGENT_FEED.md - NEEDS SIMON first, then what was flagged, then each bot's lines.

skills.name: write-feed-line
skills.description: Add one line to the team's shared feed through the writer, which removes secrets, flags a done with no receipt and signs the line with your key.
